# SSNAC III: Causality {#sec-causal-interpretation}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple"}
## Versions of this appendix

**Current version: 17 November 2026.** This revision numbers the formal definitions C.1–C.28 in a single sequence that follows the order of the argument, the numbering used in the accompanying seminar materials; the table below maps the previous numbers to the new ones. It folds neighborhood, network weights and network values into the network graph (C.18); deletes loyalty, which positional invariance implies, the network exposure mapping, folded into homogeneous network interference, and positivity, which is a condition for identification rather than part of the framework; adds the covariate (C.7); renames "no within-covariate influence" to "no contagion", "identical distributions" to "identical structural distributions", the NPSEM-GE to the random network NPSEM (C.24) and the bipartite NPSEM-GE to the bipartite random network NPSEM (C.27). The graph generator is now defined inside C.24. In the bipartite case each person's network weights belong to their observational unit, so the BRNFFRCISTG (C.28) is an RNFFRCISTG whose random network NPSEM is bipartite, with no assumption of its own. The RNFFRCISTG (C.26) assumes single-world independence with each graph generator taken as a single variable. Single-world independence (C.13) is checked in the causal model under the regime that sets every variable, by sequential substitution, which gives Robins's one-step-ahead counterfactuals.

**Previous version: 15 November 2026.** This revision rewords most formal definitions; puts single-world independence in place of the NPSEM-IE as Definition C.4; adds Definitions C.34 (directed acyclic graph) and C.35 (positivity); rests the identification arguments on single-world independence rather than independent errors; renames "no spillover" to "no within-covariate influence"; and adds citations, including to the earlier work in which the network methods were developed. All other definition numbers are unchanged. DOI for this version: [10.5281/zenodo.24263494](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24263494).

**Earlier version: 12 September 2026.** The source and rendered page, exactly as they stood, are at commit [`7b18acd`](https://github.com/mpxnyc/mpxnyc.github.io/tree/7b18acd4cf4202934b0ec9aaffe3ee3530ca1975) ([rendered appendix](https://github.com/mpxnyc/mpxnyc.github.io/blob/7b18acd4cf4202934b0ec9aaffe3ee3530ca1975/_book/C_causality.html)).

Every earlier version is kept in this site's public history on GitHub: see the history of the appendix's [sections](https://github.com/mpxnyc/mpxnyc.github.io/commits/development/__C_causality) and [definitions](https://github.com/mpxnyc/mpxnyc.github.io/commits/development/___definitions). Versions from 15 November 2026 onward are archived on Zenodo, each with its own DOI; [10.5281/zenodo.24263493](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24263493) covers all of them and always resolves to the latest. To cite a statement from a particular version, give that version's date and its DOI, or, for earlier versions, the commit that contains it.
